node_definition.done_when: One retention pass over a temporary crew home holding finished runs for two projects, each ledgered in its own project, removes both; a second pass with nothing left writes no log line; a pass over 1,200 removable fixtures removes 500 and leaves 700 for the next; a pass whose fixture checkout carries worktrees starts no git process, asserted by a git shim on PATH that records every call. The pass runs only gc's run-directory retention, reads each project's ledger through its ledger index rather than by parsing crew.json, and appends its removals through the watch log's rotating stream (_WatchLogStream in reckon/crew/watch_unit.py). Installing writes a service and an hourly timer under a temporary systemd user directory, and a second install writes nothing. The write-and-enable steps are one generic function in reckon/service.py, modelled on install_timer in reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py, which is held by another run and is not changed here. On the base commit neither the pass nor the timer exists, so the test fails there. Gate: tests/test_the_retention_sweep_runs_on_its_own.py tests/test_crew_gc.py tests/test_only_a_run_something_can_still_need_keeps_its_directory.py plus every existing test module that imports reckon/service.py, named in the manifest, and tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py. The width test's reckon/roadmap.py failure is pre-existing on main. Run the gate in the foreground on the fleet allocation, with the revision, tree and command on the log's first line; ruff check and ruff format --check report nothing added on the staged paths.
